title: Super Mario Bros World 1-1 Clone
why: Build a playable HTML/JS clone of SMB1 World 1-1 in the html-game project alongside Galaga
outcomes: Playable level 1-1 with Mario physics, enemies, blocks, pipes, flag pole, scoring, and game-over/restart

milestones.name: Engine
milestones.objective: Core game loop, canvas rendering, input handling, and entity system
milestones.success: Game loop running at 60fps, input responsive, entities can be spawned and rendered
milestones.diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Game Loop] --> B[Update]
  A --> C[Render]
  B --> D[Input]
  B --> E[Physics]
  B --> F[Collision]
  B --> G[Entities]
  C --> H[Canvas 2D]
  D --> I[Keyboard]
  D --> J[Touch]

tasks.name: Canvas setup and game loop
tasks.what: Create index.html with canvas and main.js with requestAnimationFrame game loop
tasks.why: Foundation for all rendering and game logic
acceptance: Canvas renders at 800x480
Game loop runs at 60fps with delta time

tasks.name: Input handling and camera system
tasks.what: Add keyboard input manager (Arrow keys + Z/X) and scrolling camera that follows Mario
tasks.why: Player needs controls and the level needs to scroll horizontally
acceptance: Arrow keys tracked in real-time
Camera follows player and clamps to level bounds

tasks.name: Entity base class and sprite system
tasks.what: Create base Entity class with position, velocity, and sprite rendering via pixel art tilemap
tasks.why: All game objects (Mario, enemies, blocks) share common behavior
acceptance: Sprite sheet loaded and sub-images can be extracted
Entity can be positioned and rendered relative to camera

milestones.name: Mario
milestones.objective: Mario character with movement, jumping, gravity, big/m small states, and death animation
milestones.success: Mario runs, jumps, grows with mushroom, and dies on enemy contact
milestones.diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Small
    Small --> Big: Mushroom
    Big --> Small: Hit
    Small --> Dead: Enemy
    Big --> Dead: Enemy
    Dead --> [*]: Game Over

tasks.name: Mario physics and movement
tasks.what: Implement Mario with gravity, acceleration, max speed, and variable-height jumping
tasks.why: Mario needs authentic platforming feel — snappy controls with momentum
acceptance: Mario accelerates and decelerates smoothly
Mario falls with gravity when off ground
Speed caps at max (200 px/s)

tasks.name: Mario jumping and states
tasks.what: Add variable-height jumping, big/small states, mushroom powerup, and death/invincibility
tasks.why: Iconic SMB mechanics — short tap = short hop, hold = full jump, states affect collision
acceptance: Short tap of jump = small hop
Hold jump = full height
Mushroom grows Mario from 16px to 32px tall
Big Mario shrinks on enemy contact, becomes invulnerable for 2s
Small Mario dies on enemy contact

milestones.name: Level
milestones.objective: World 1-1 layout with ground, pipes, blocks, gaps, and flag pole
milestones.success: Full 1-1 level loads, renders, and is traversable from start to flag
milestones.diagram:
flowchart LR
    A[Level Data] --> B[Tilemap Parser]
    B --> C[Ground Tiles]
    B --> D[Pipe Sprites]
    B --> E[Question Blocks]
    B --> F[Brick Blocks]
    B --> G[Gaps / Pits]
    B --> H[Flag Pole]

tasks.name: Tilemap parser and ground rendering
tasks.what: Create tilemap data structure for 1-1 and render ground, walls, and static tiles
tasks.why: Level layout needs a structured format for collision and rendering
acceptance: Ground tiles render continuously across the level
Only visible tiles are rendered (culling)
getTile returns correct tile ID for any world position

tasks.name: World 1-1 layout data
tasks.what: Encode the actual 1-1 level layout: ground, pipes, blocks, gaps, staircase, flag
tasks.why: The defining content — needs to match the original level layout closely
acceptance: Level has ground from start to flag with 3 pits
5 pipes placed at correct positions
Question blocks with mushrooms and coins placed
Staircase section before flag pole
Flag pole at end of level

tasks.name: Tile collision system
tasks.what: AABB collision between Mario and solid tiles (ground, bricks, pipes, blocks)
tasks.why: Mario needs to stand on ground, hit blocks from below, and clip against pipes
acceptance: Mario stands on ground without falling through
Mario stops when walking into a pipe
Mario head bounces off brick from below
Mario falls through pits (no ground tile)

milestones.name: Enemies
milestones.objective: Goombas and Koopas with walking AI, stomp-to-kill, and contact-damage
milestones.success: Enemies spawn, walk, get stomped, and hurt Mario on side contact
milestones.diagram:
flowchart LR
    A[Enemy Spawn] --> B[Walk Left]
    B --> C{Collision}
    C --> D[Mario Stomps]
    C --> E[Mario Touches Side]
    C --> F[Hits Wall / Pipe]
    D --> G[Flattened / Shell]
    E --> H[Mario Takes Damage]
    F --> I[Reverse Direction]

tasks.name: Goomba enemy
tasks.what: Implement Goomba: walks left at constant speed, dies when stomped, kills Mario on side contact
tasks.why: Classic first enemy — teaches stomp mechanic
acceptance: Goomba walks left continuously
Stomped goomba flattens and disappears after 0.5s
Side contact with living goomba damages Mario
Stomping awards 100 points

tasks.name: Koopa enemy
tasks.what: Implement Koopa Troopa: walks, retreats into shell when stomped, shell slides when kicked
tasks.why: Adds shell mechanic — kicked shells kill other enemies
acceptance: Koopa walks left at constant speed
Stomp turns Koopa into idle shell
Touching idle shell kicks it across screen
Moving shell kills other enemies on contact

milestones.name: Gameplay
milestones.objective: Question blocks, bricks, mushrooms, coins, HUD, and game-over/level-complete flow
milestones.success: Full gameplay loop: play, score, die, restart, reach flag for level complete
milestones.diagram:
flowchart LR
    A[Mario Head-Bumps Block] --> B[Question Block]
    A --> C[Brick Block]
    B --> D[Mushroom / Coin]
    C --> E[Breaks if Big]
    C --> F[Shakes if Small]
    D --> G[Mario Grows / Score Up]
    H[Mario Reaches Flag] --> I[Slide Down Pole]
    I --> J[Level Complete Screen]
    K[Mario Dies] --> L[Game Over]
    L --> M[Restart]

tasks.name: Block interaction and powerups
tasks.what: Question blocks spawn mushrooms/coins when hit from below; bricks break or shake
tasks.why: Core SMB interaction — blocks give powerups and score
acceptance: Head-bumping question block bounces it up
Mushroom question block spawns moving mushroom
Coin question block awards 200 points
Used block stays used (no respawn)
Big Mario breaks brick blocks
Small Mario only shakes brick blocks

tasks.name: HUD, scoring, and game states
tasks.what: Add HUD (score, coins, time, lives) and game states: playing, game-over, level-complete
tasks.why: Player needs feedback and the game needs win/lose conditions
acceptance: HUD shows score, coins, time, lives at top of screen
Timer counts down from 400
Mario death decrements lives
Game over at 0 lives shows restart screen
Reaching flag pole triggers level complete with score based on height

milestones.name: Polish
milestones.objective: Authentic look and feel with pixel art sprites, background, clouds, hills, bushes, and sound effects
milestones.success: Game looks and sounds like classic SMB with proper 16px pixel art
milestones.diagram:
flowchart LR
    A[Sprite Sheet] --> B[Mario Frames]
    A --> C[Enemy Frames]
    A --> D[Block Tiles]
    A --> E[Background]
    F[Sound Effects] --> G[Jump]
    F --> H[Coin]
    F --> I[Powerup]
    F --> J[Bump]
    F --> K[Death]

tasks.name: Sprite sheet and pixel art assets
tasks.what: Create 16px pixel art sprite sheet with Mario (walk, jump, big), Goomba, Koopa, blocks, pipes, background
tasks.why: Game needs visual assets — can use public domain pixel art or generate programmatically
acceptance: Sprite sheet loads without errors
All entity sprites render at correct 16px scale
Background renders parallax clouds, hills, bushes

tasks.name: Sound effects
tasks.what: Add jump, coin, powerup, bump, stomp, death, and kick sounds using Web Audio API
tasks.why: Audio completes the authentic SMB experience
acceptance: Jump sound plays on jump input
Coin sound plays on coin collection
Bump sound plays on block head-hit
Death sound plays on Mario death
